summary: It's Not Rocket Science is a 2D space exploration game where players take on space exploration missions, build and customize their own rockets using various components, and independently carry out missions to explore space. Players can experiment with different rocket designs, make their own decisions, and experience the journey of space exploration through hands-on gameplay.
details:
PROJECT DETAILS

It's Not Science Rocket is a 2D space exploration and rocket-building game that allows players to experience space exploration through a series of assigned missions. Players design and assemble their own rockets using various components before launching them to accomplish specific mission objectives. The game combines rocket construction, mission-based gameplay, and basic scientific concepts to introduce players to space exploration in an interactive and accessible way.

How it works:

Players are assigned space exploration missions with specific objectives. They must design and assemble their own rockets using available components to meet the mission requirements. Once the rocket is ready, players launch it and carry out the assigned mission themselves.

Key Benefits & Impact:

  • Encourages creativity: Allows players to independently design and assemble rockets using different components.
  • Develops problem-solving skills: Challenges players to find suitable rocket configurations to meet mission objectives.
  • Introduces space science: Provides basic knowledge of rocket components and space exploration.
  • Promotes independent learning: Encourages experimentation through hands-on gameplay.
  • Raises interest in STEM: Connects scientific concepts with interactive entertainment.

Tools & Technologies:

  • Procreate: Digital illustration and creation of 2D visual assets, including game graphics and illustrations.
  • Canva: Graphic design, visual composition, and creation of presentation and design materials.

AI-Assisted Development:

  • Claude AI: Assisted in programing the game structure and outlining core gameplay concepts.
  • AI-Assisted Asset Creation: Used to help generate and develop selected rocket components and visual assets for the game.
  • AI-Assisted Ideation: Supported brainstorming and exploration of game mechanics and design concepts during early development.

Creative Elements:

  • Features an assigned mission system in which the game provides specific space exploration objectives.
  • Includes an interactive rocket-building system that allows players to assemble and customize their own rockets.
  • Provides a hands-on launch experience, allowing players to independently carry out missions.
  • Connects rocket construction with mission objectives, encouraging thoughtful component selection.
  • Integrates basic scientific concepts into gameplay through interactive experiences.
  • Uses a 2D space-themed visual style to create an engaging environment for players interested in science and space exploration.
